name: Raj Bakhru
bio: Raj Bakhru is Chief Technology Officer at Datasite, where he leads the technology organization and advances its AI-native, secure, and scalable infrastructure. He joined Datasite through its acquisition of Blueflame AI, where he was CEO and Co-Founder. Previously, he held senior technology, strategy, and cybersecurity roles at ACA Group, ACA Aponix, and Goldman Sachs Asset Management.

sessions.title: How Raj Led Datasite’s AI and Data Transformation at Scale with Reducto
